lines.x: Russia's actions in the Black Sea are raising shipping insurance costs for Bulgaria, cancelling ship-repair contracts and reducing business activity.
The US has authorized the sale of Serbian oil company NIS's Bulgarian and Romanian businesses, including 22 Gazprom-branded stations in Bulgaria.
Bulgaria's National Assembly ratified an agreement with Germany to jointly buy five additional IRIS-T SLM systems under the EU's SAFE instrument.
Greece's Eurobank has signed a preliminary agreement to buy a 65% stake in First Investment Bank.
